summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored lore destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, faction standing and resume location. Shared player behaviors and place simulations connect authored spaces with generated layouts, encounters and quests, while Slate and Bulk Data Manager add creator-facing studio and registry tools.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and generated dressing; cells/objects.scene also places the invisible Bulk Data Manager object.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells/.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destination doors, camps, crew and quest props; distinct from Bonus room routing.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation, waking, staged tutorial and HALOGEN handoff to Dina's lead.
places/level9 (3D, The Suburbs) - room-seeded streets and five fitted house types; furnished, wallpapered living/bedroom interiors, warm lights, hinged front doors and breakable searchable furniture.
places/level11 (3D) - Sedco Spotlight and city blocks; sim.js uses shared city and vault/depth builders for the subway, Sedco vault and Robotics crawl/storeroom.
places/level01, level02, level1-7, level10-13, level21, level26-27, level31, level70 (3D) - authored lore destinations; Level 11 includes Sedco CCTV and street-grate access.
places/gamma, spamton, testlab (3D) - additional authored destinations and test space.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local config, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior.
sim.js - global tick for body-style propagation and bounded incremental restyling in occupied places.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts + scripts/ui.js - title, character creation, arrival/tutorial, Dina routing and composed HUD/menus.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and HUD zone naming.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + xmas-room.js + level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic dressing/encounters.
places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - versioned Hub topology, doors, dressing and crew.
mods/slate/mod.json + panel.js + input.js; mods/bulk-data-manager/mod.json + creator-data-ui.js - creator tablet and database-manager mod entry points.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts - Bonus shared-room routing, solo IDs, home destinations, labels and proximity preload; distinct from places/thehub.
scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - canonical Hub tunnels, door/key registry and position helpers; shared by geometry, simulation, quests, doors and UI.

scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - common loot/items and weapon variants; weapon-look selects fitted meshes or scripted geometry. scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml catalogs appearance assets, including gendered hair variants for wardrobe-ui.js.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric doors/motion and deterministic paired Level 3 hatches.
scripts/lib/data/l9-houses.yml + l9-props.yml + scripts/lib/level9.js - Level 9 house/model/door and prop catalogs plus pure seed-driven layout; consumed by places/level9/sim.js and zone lookup.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + l02-remodel.yml + l02-grid.js; breakables.js + breakable data + wallgrid.js - Level 0.2 remodel and shared prop/generated-wall damage and regrowth.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + quest-mark.js + quests.js + errands.js - directed crossings and shared quest/errand journal, tracker, rewards and step messaging.
scripts/lib/hunt.js - shared creature sensing, shot stamps, wall steering/wedge recovery and canStrike geometry check; used by hunting enemies.
notableExports: scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate, wakeLog.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V, sw194, furrySpec, restyle, restyleQueue, restyleStep, restylePlace; scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, stagger3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands.
scripts/lib/level9.js - HOUSES, ROAD_W, rng, hashStr, yawFacing, layout, zoneAt; places/level9/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level31-parts.js - venue geometry/zones/arrivals/skating/layParts and quest QID/QNAME/openCrate/useDeck/choice/dialogue exports.
scripts/lib/level70-quest.js + scripts/terrain70.js - Level 70 quest, terrain and civic/life layer exports.
scripts/lib/errands.js - ERRANDS, held, errandText, offerErrand, payErrand, tryAlt, deliberateErrands, turnInErrand, errandTick.

scripts/lib/rep.js - GROUPS, RIVALS, groupOf, fameOf, infamyOf, repOf, titleOf, tierOf, rankOf, addRep, addKarma, repKill/Kind/Trade/Line; scripts/lib/stats.js - ATTRS, SKILLS, SKILL_KEYS, ATTR_MAX, START, attrsOf, packAttrs, tagsOf.
scripts/lib/hunt.js - hearOf, raise, alertFor, shotAt, wallSteer, wedged, litMul, sighting, leadOf, canStrike; scripts/crawl.js - onInput, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, tapes, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats, including non-finite capacity as ∞.

scripts/critter.js - per-player look and creator/wardrobe/salon state; scripts/lib/body3.js - session.ready3 and transient me.anim.ready melee-carry pose; scripts/main-menu.js - session.tabAway, session.animPlace and place.timeScale pause.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - quests/qtrack/qdone/claimed; Dina trail keys, stages, diary/cut/clue fields and migration.

scripts/lib/errands.js - player.state.errands records, errHints and errand journal entries; completion updates currency, payout, reputation and hints; scripts/lib/field-errands.js + hub-errands.js own confirmation maps.

scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level70-quest.js + remodel-quest.js + scripts/lib/level11-quests.js - their level-specific quest stages, routes and rewards; Level 11 progress is stored under player.state.quests/qdone and related quest keys.
scripts/lib/rep.js - player.state.fame/infamy by faction, compatibility net rep for legacy readers, karma and bounded repHistory; fame/infamy drive faction titles/ranks and hostility checks.

places/level9/sim.js - per-room l9seed, generated house/street layout, fog, l9DressV curb dressing and generated container/furniture state; Bulk Data Manager owns collection metadata/records, while Slate writes shared world plans.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest and CCTV behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js add game-specific play.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; zoneHere → maze and authored level labels, including Level 9 zoneAt.

scripts/lib/body3.js tick3 → third-person body pose: camera rotation supplies aim yaw/pitch; combat-anims.yml family rows drive gun/melee clips, and session.ready3 selects a ready melee carry except during swings or disabled states.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to mall/home and maintain roomHop/save-place, separate from places/thehub; fresh visit → main-menu.js, START routes to intake or Bonus, and wardrobe close routes to tutorial0 first time or main later.
scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands → quests.js journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts.
talk.js openDialogue → npc-starters.js questChoices (including faction and M.E.G. assignment choices); selected text → level-specific/Hub/errand handlers, factionReply or megAssignmentReply.

tutorial0 HALOGEN cut → tut0-cut.js + dina-quest.js; diaries/cuts/clues across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ; Dina quest tick routes to The Tenth Tunnel at dinaQ 9 or hubPhoebe.
places/level1/sim.js l1-to-hub → scripts/level-door.js crossing → thehub; hub-from-l1 returns to arrival position; Level 1 zoneAt classifies KEEP bounds and labels.

places/thehub/sim.js → lib/thehub.js and hub-people.js/hub-dress.js versioned shell, doors, props, crew and camps; hub-door-geo.js renders doors, hub-door.js handles use/crossing, plaques label destinations.

places/level9/sim.js reads scripts/lib/level9.js layout, l9-houses.yml and furniture.yml → fitted shells, hinged doors, clean living/bedroom interiors, furniture and searchable containers; scripts/lib/loot.js rolls contents.

scripts/crawl.js reads crouch/jump and low-ceiling/tunnel geometry → player.state.crawl/crouch and capsule/animation; enemy scripts call scripts/lib/hunt.js canStrike before bites/slashes, checking reach, floor and obstruction.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored shops/props and simulated staff; Block Panic and Squeeze Play are separate playable counters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; home11 and Level 5 use separate buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates a crawl, tight ceilings/tunnel mouths trigger automatic crawl, and it auto-stands after clear headroom.
Level 01/Zenith and Level 1 geometry builders - authored station and car park/service geometry; corridor materials, pipes, fixtures and lights vary deterministically per cell.
scripts/meg-agent.js + npc-temper.js + forgive.js + critter-model.js - NPC reactions, cover, barks, movement/fighting and companion following; faction, role, outfit and assault incidents vary by NPC.
scripts/duller-spawn.js + duller-spec.js + scripts/lib/data/dullers.yml - shared Duller spec for ambient spawn and Foe Bay; per-place caps/chances and 240-second per-player rolls tune its rarity.

places/level9/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/l9-houses.yml + art/l9-houses/fit.py + plan.py - five house types use measured interior bounds and +Z-facing fitted models; seeded rooms share wallpaper, bedroom, furnishings, breakage/search and street dressing.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

The Hub run frame/coordinates are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; u follows a run, v spans its width, +X trunk, side tunnels alternate north/south. Preserve door IDs, mappings and coordinates together; Hub place.state.hubV versions its shell.

Level 9 keeps l9seed, fog and looted contents across generated rebuilds. places/level9/sim.js layout V=13 rebuilds houses/interiors but carries items/scavved/lock from existing containers; l9DressV independently versions curbside details.

Level 9 house contract: fitted models are grounded and centred in catalog w×d footprints, with front at file +Z; keep each l9-houses.yml interior dimensions and door x/z/y aligned to the 1 m × 2.1 m hole and rotated sim hinge/stoop.

scripts/crawl.js stores crawl state on the player and restores the reduced capsule after reload; standing requires clear 1.95 m headroom. Automatic crawl is limited to a low ceiling or low opening/tunnel mouth; only automatic crawls auto-stand when clear.

Weapon meshes fitted by art/weapons/build.py and art/weapons/fit.json must stay in scripts/lib/weapon-look.js's scripted frame: mesh offsets and hand-grip transforms determine placement; body3's hand offsets and carry poses are coupled to held weapon geometry.
